notes.title: Weapon & Ammo System Overhaul & More | Demo Update 0.13.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685803/3d2d1de689dc7d0f36551c35f80ffa1ef673eae2.gif[/img]
[h2]Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon & Ammo Overhaul (See [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1319550/view/2951510987399092855]this post for details[/url])
[*]One new weapon with a new status effect that will be used more and more
[*]Several upgrades have been reworked or rebuilt completely to accommodate the new weapon system.
[*]New United Trade Federation reputation mechanic.
[/list]

[h2]UI Redesign[/h2]
[list]
[*]Full map shows other details to the players (like max ammo values and past log messages) than standard game UI
[*]Ammo UI completely rebuilt to accommodate the 4 new weapons types
[*]Health UI now has a better indication of what Armor charges do
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685803/3187bb5a0495a51e6dea3c94e6846f662f1901f7.gif[/img]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rerolling item container interaction has been reworked: You now hold [F] to reroll an item container and just press [F] once to open it. Copy has been adjusted to better indicate that you don’t have to pay to open them.
[*]New shield generator animation and sprites
[*]Star Former ability does not change the controls.
[*]Trade dialog has been slightly tweaked to make it more clear what you get out of a trade.
[*]Multiple trade options have been removed due to the weapon system overhaul.
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]You cannot take damage shortly after exiting a warp.
[*]Most large ships have had their health buffed a small amount to compensate for the ammo rework.
[*]Several enemies have higher turn speeds to ensure they won’t get left too far behind by the pack.
[*]Mine enemies will throw their mines in your direction instead of dropping them behind themselves.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a turret crash for modular ships warping out of the system
[*]Fixed a bug where spamming clicking buttons would cause them to perform their action repeatedly
[*]If you are transferring resources and the target changes you will no longer continue transferring to that new target without additional input.
[/list]

Additional changes as of 12/14/20:

[list]
[*]You can find ammo boxes scattered throughout the systems
[*]Enemies will have a much higher chance to drop ammo (except for extremely weak enemies, they will have a lower chance)
[*]Asteroid health reduced a bit to make it not eat up so much ammo
[*]Ammo boxes will refill based on your max ammo (10% of your max) so as you increase your max you will get more from boxes.
[*]Ammo max increased to 250 at the beginning (And you start with that much in your starting weapon).
[*]Some optimization changes aimed at increasing performance in larger systems.
[/list]

Additional changes as of 12/22/20:

[list]
[*]Six new weapons to help balance out the ammo types.
[*]Some other weapons have been moved to different ammo types to help balance out the ammo types.
[*]Drastically reduced armor of ship debris to match the armor reduction of asteroids.
[*]Fixed a bug where buttons where not clickable when you went to the pause screen and back.
[*]Fixed a bug where cooldown reducing effects were not displaying correctly on the UI.
[*]Fixed a bug where travel pod was not showing it's input key for activation.

[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update: New disabled ship mechanics, warp gate and asteroids refresh.
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Got a fresh update here for the demo. I'm working on polishing up some demo items in preparation for the full game. Here's a list of what's changed:

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disabled playable ships found in the systems will now have stats associated with them (rather than taking your current stats). You can use these to your advantage if you are having a bad run and need a life boost or just want to find some alternative weapons.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused planet attacking enemies to not fire if they were really far away from you. In fixing this I've reduced the number of attacks these enemies produce to help keep the difficulty similar.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused large ships to spawn too closely to a planet, giving little time for the player to react.
[*]By default the map uses "Tab" as it's keybind. Which should be less of a stretch for you hands!
[*]Some slower enemies have had their speed increased. I didn't like how they'd show up late for the party all the time...
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now see your secondary weapons on the UI
[/list]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685803/6705e09cea2e1f2e859e8543bddd003877df9c6c.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Asteroids have had a facelift. I didn't like how poorly they fit in the environment so I reworked the all.
[*]Warp gate has had a facelift. This was a placeholder sprite that I've just gotten around to updating.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685803/2156589747207f1899376d523719763d7c73b23c.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where drop upgrades (like Overload) would stop spawning in certain scenarios
[*]Fixed a bug where drop upgrades (like Overload) would cause you to loose focus on the item currently selected
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
A lot of optimization in this version. Some players were experiencing slow down near the end of larger systems. I've made literally hundreds of tweaks here and there to significantly improve the performance of the game as well as clean up a few memory leaks I noticed.

notes.title: Modular ship updates, QoL UI updates and bug fixes | Demo update 0.12.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38685803/97d87b0bca7d9fd2edc472cc791e9a6511304f3e.gif[/img]

Hey folks, a small update here to clean up some loose ends with the demo version.

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*]A handful of new sprites for modular ships, a few of these combos felt "small" to me so I wanted them to be a bit more imposing. I also cleaned up a few who's art style didn't quite fit with the rest.
[*]Mines behave differently now. When activated they will pulse and then trigger after a short time. This gives some opportunity smart play to factor into mine fights.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*]Warp gates have a better indication of where you are going to be traveling to.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can no longer warp to the gate you are currently at, which would disabled the gate and waste your time.
[*] Fixed some bugs with saving and the system creation (Game would crash when entering the travel pod).
[*] Buff stations and warp gates should no longer spawn on top of each other which caused the player to lose control if they interacted with one.
[*] Fixed broken the "Demo Completed" message and added some additional calls to action here.
[/list]

notes.title: Starter upgrades and difficulty adjustments | Demo Update 0.12.5
notes.content:
I've made some significant changes to the beginning of the game to accomplish two goals:

[olist]
[*] Giving newer players a zone to experiment without the pressure of enemies attacking the system constantly.
[*] Give all players a very powerful upgrade that will influence choices they make about what weapons to use and what upgrades to pick up from that point on.
[/olist]

In the latest update you'll start in a system with only one planet. No enemies will spawn to attack the planet (though you may run into some in the system) and it is stripped of a lot of "advanced" mechanics. This system should act as a safe zone if you just want to play around with your newly unlocked ship for a while or if you are a brand new player who needs to grow accustom to the controls and the flow of the game.

When you complete that system you will be given the regular rewards along with an upgrade that you will only ever get once in the game. These upgrades are specifically designed to be extremely powerful and should cause you to think twice about how they synergism with the items/weapons/upgrades you pick up in the future. They will also offer some run to run variety even while player the same ship as it will be usually advantageous to build your ship around them.

Once you enter the next system the game will start "as usual" enemies will spawn to attack planets and advanced mechanics will return.

My hope for all this is that players will be able to naturally "figure out" the core gameplay loop in the first system where there's little else to do so that when they hit the next system and there is enemy pressure they don't get frustrated and give up. One of the biggest pieces of feedback I've gotten is that players haven't found out what they should be "doing" in the game. I despise tutorials and I want to avoid adding something that doesn't feel natural so this is an approach I'm taking to accomplish the same goal of a tutorial.

Other changes include:

[list]
[*] Reduced the threshold for increasing your max armor by 2 (to 4) but every time you increase it the threshold will increase by 1 the next time.
[*] Enemies will start spawning sooner that they used to in the 2nd system.
[*] fixed several upgrades (like Extreme Overload) where the pickups would stop dropping after you interacted with a menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't back out of an upgrade UI with Escape.
[*] Fixed a bug where one soundtrack would continue to play despite turning down the music slider
[/list]
